material_gaps_found.title: Separate the four cost layers in REQ-RESOURCE-ECONOMICS and REQ-PHYSICAL-WORKLOAD-1-10-100
material_gaps_found.why_material: The frozen frame names 1/10/100, retained/scratch/output and 6 GiB, but does not distinguish cold validation H, index build S, per-operation scientific counting Q and evidence-output amplification O. The current prepared-session result removes only S, and the 1.69-1.70x author report cannot be extrapolated to 100 operations. Without this split an architecture can appear to satisfy repeated-operation economics while Q or O dominates.
source_grounding: #1097 current body: 3033.723 s writer, 310.16 MB retained, 1.30 GB native session index, 562.362 s pre-W05 selected query, prepared 1.69-1.70x author report
#1006 G2 measurement plan items (5)-(10): cold open, index rebuild, first I03/reverse F2/F4, 10 same-process, 10 fresh-process, fact/replay finalization
material_gaps_found.proposed_requirement: Every 1/10/100 claim must report H, S, Q and O separately for same-process and fresh-process opens, with fact/replay parity and peak process-tree RSS; no extrapolation from a small operation-count factor.

material_gaps_found.title: Derived durable query index proof, binding and invalidation contract
material_gaps_found.why_material: A persisted posting/locator index is the only route that removes S from a one-operation fresh open, but the frame has no explicit contract for a derived index. #1097 states a derived index is not presumed disposable until rebuild economics are proven. Without a binding/proof/invalidation rule a producer-self-hashed index could become a second corpus or a stale authority source.
source_grounding: #1097: 'A derived index is not presumed disposable until rebuild economics are proven'; current DirectEstateI03Session recreates temp SQLite indexed postings per session; VerifiedDirectEstate rehashes members on cold init
pre553_direct_estate_i03.py indices_for single-universe/release refusal; pre553_source_direct_parquet_estate.py manifest/member hashes
material_gaps_found.proposed_requirement: Any derived query index must (a) store no canonical bodies/evidence, only locators/selection metadata; (b) bind to the exact estate manifest SHA, I02 roots, release, replay, universe, family censuses, row-group topology and schema; (c) be independently validated on open after H; (d) refuse on any source/root/currentness/authority/wave change; (e) have owner, rebuild/restore and revocation procedures; (f) pass a retained-size and 6 GiB gate before adoption.

material_gaps_found.title: Exact evidence-output sharing and replay contract
material_gaps_found.why_material: Facts currently carry full risk_set_member_refs and denominator_member_refs; 100 distinct operations can amplify evidence output independently of query cost. The frame requires output evidence/replay preservation but does not say when exact set refs may be shared or when replay must re-execute.
source_grounding: pre553_empirical_query.py replay_empirical_query: re-executes and requires exact fact identities; cache/materialization is nonauthoritative
material_gaps_found.proposed_requirement: Evidence output may reference content-addressed exact risk/denominator set objects only when the exact population, condition, routing, measure regime and wave identity are identical; forward/reverse F2, weighted/unweighted, missing/routing and cross-wave sets must remain separate. Replay of an identical operation must re-execute and compare exact fact refs; a cached fact is never authoritative.
